# HTMLP 0.2

A strict markup format for prompt files with explicit token limits.

Save as .htmlp:
<htmlp max-tokens="1k" reason="Shared context.">
<section id="workflow">Make one change. Test it.</section>
</htmlp>

Check: htmlp check ./prompts
Every declared max-tokens or max-item-tokens requires a nonblank reason on that element.
Each file is independent; no external configuration or directory inheritance.
1k = 1000 tokens. Default encoding: cl100k_base, not a universal model tokenizer.
Use section IDs for lookup. var needs id, max-tokens, reason, and an explicit closing tag.
Escape literal < and & in Markdown. Unknown markup fails.
render checks static reservations, bindings, and final text.
Inline limits and reasons are editable; policy changes need review.

Guide: {{BASE}}/docs/
Specification: {{BASE}}/spec.md
Schema: {{BASE}}/document.schema.json
Rust API: {{BASE}}/api/htmlp/index.html
Source: https://github.com/alexmckenley/htmlp
